source: Real Sprite Tools web app (static export served locally) and CLI. No mock UI. Cards A and B draw the Collision tool's exported polygon, unedited, over the demo sprite.

demoInputs.what: Quiet Brass mouse, the character on the October 2026 LinkedIn card
demoInputs.provenance: Generated image: concept sheets and the side-on pose made 2026-10-21 with the coding agent's built-in image_gen tool to Rico's brief (he chose Quiet Brass); background cut out with Sprite Tools; green spill clamped 2026-10-23; scaled to 720 px 2026-11-07.

demoInputs.what: Beetle, used for Sheet Lint, Aseprite import, Export and the CLI capture
demoInputs.provenance: excalibur-aseprite test fixture, BSD-2-Clause, see NOTICE there

fonts: Geist and Geist Mono (OFL-1.1), as shipped in the next package

files.purpose: Demo input: the Quiet Brass mouse, 720x476 RGBA.
files.madeBy: ImageMagick 7 (Lanczos, -strip) from the 1294x855 master; see README.md, Demo inputs

files.purpose: README hero: Collision tool, the mouse with its 76-point polygon (dark theme, dark preview grid).
